design.reviewGate: Commit this specification and require explicit user approval before any corpus generation or evaluation. This phase authorizes no provider calls.
design.roster: 30 primary sources, 12 independent secondary sources, 90 readable distractor records, 6 restricted bundles, 2 fixed sources and 10 unrelated records. Each restricted bundle contains five independent claims for one cohort and split.
design.titleLexicalIsolation: For every title and all 30 questions, NFKC-normalize and lowercase, extract contiguous Unicode letter tokens of at least three characters, strip an ending ing, ed, es or s from tokens longer than five characters, and require an empty intersection. Numeric filing numbers are unrelated to case IDs, roles and projects.
design.generationBoundary: The prose provider receives only an opaque document identifier, neutral title, document kind, generic brief and generic section instructions. Drafting receives no case questions, label text, expected dispositions, marker offsets, role, group or split. The local assembler inserts the separately declared anchor sentences. Retrieval receives only readable canonical source text, actor scope and the open questions. Case labels, expected answers, supporting-document lists, anchor offsets and distractor categories stay with the offline validator and scorer.

filler.instructions: Write substantive internal records around the document subject with fictional people, calendar dates, quantities and substantive decisions about neighboring administrative work. Derive those specifics independently of the case anchors. Use dates and quantities naturally in decisions, observations, exceptions and follow-ups. Avoid templated headers, padding, repeated sentences, standalone record identifiers as quantities, and definitive claims about the outcome of the main project or the metric that determines it.
filler.denominator: Segment fitted prose bodies and exact anchor blocks with Intl.Segmenter en, excluding Markdown headings, marker lines and blanks. Count distinct real ISO calendar dates, such as 2026-10-06. Mask date spans before counting standalone written numerals, amounts, currency, percentages and units, including hyphenated quantities such as 10-day. Spelled numbers and digits embedded only in record, person or project IDs do not count. Report the number of sentences with a quantity, with a date and with either for supporting labels, distractor labels and filler. Apply the 15-point maximum absolute gap separately to support versus filler, distractors versus filler and all evaluation labels versus filler. The two fixed policy excerpts are outside these label denominators. Report the corpus breakdown and split or document-kind counts where defined.
filler.additionalValidation: Retain v1 size, UTF-8 position, marker, canonical hash, exact/normalized sentence and label leakage and repetition checks. Apply section density floors after fitting paragraphs and before inserting anchors. Check the minimum counts against the neutral subject of the section and review representative documents from each kind for unrelated administrative specifics. Report this measurable lexical proxy and its limits, along with within-section variation.

design.temporalCoverage: Every case is scored only at its own week cutoff. Every readable distractor remains the latest version of a separate eligible document at that cutoff. Four case files have earlier drafts and ten independent administrative records update in each later week. The earlier primary drafts are unlabeled. The restricted documents also exist by the applicable cutoff and are expressly excluded by ACL.
design.cataloguePressure: Each cutoff features 54 newly published or updated actor-readable non-fixed candidates: 14 case-support sources, 30 readable distractors, and ten unrelated records. At 35,000 bytes each these fit within the production 2 MB parent acquisition budget while exceeding the 50-entry catalogue. The four independent secondary records each week are published earlier than the other 50 candidates. This makes them valid lexical ranking candidates outside a recency-only catalogue. Earlier cohorts and history provide additional tenant inventory. Measure acquisition, offered and frozen support independently. Availability and actual offer are distinct observations.
design.groupDeclaration: For each split and cutoff, the five cases form one quintet and two triples. Each triple has one two-document case. The middle single-document case is repeated across the triples. Count unique cases and grouped occurrences separately.

comparison.reporting: Retain v1 evidence and reliability metrics plus supporting document versions offered and selected. For cases with two required documents, report both present in acquisition, both offered, both frozen and strict passage coverage in both. Report the four distractor categories independently. Include failures and zero evidence counts. Treat a restricted disclosure as an error in every arm.
comparison.sequence: Lock ingestion, retrieval and scoring settings before dev retrieval, complete dev before held-out, then run held-out retrieval once with the same settings. Use a single shared exploration per group and cap for the three authorized live snapshots. Use the held-out captures only for scoring and reporting.

spending.provider: Azure GPT-6 Luna on the configured Azure routes.
spending.policy: Approval is mandatory. Maintain separate durable spend ledgers and reserve every request before sending it. Recompute forecasts for the locked 174-version corpus and 54 explorations with explicit maximum tokens and retry bounds. Use v1 measured usage for comparable exploration costs. Bound cold digests for a split from its public ACL and version inventory before that split runs, then refine from the actual offered union returned by its deterministic arms. Stop before model calls if the forecast exceeds the relevant cap, and prevent every dispatch that would breach it. Adapt the v1 fixed-count schema and projection after review while preserving the locked roster and retrieval limits.

design.expectedMarkerBehavior: Build every document version independently. Each anchor marker occurs once before insertion and zero times in canonical text. Matching uses exact source version and the UTF-16 range in its canonical text. Preserve the labelled sentence bytes and intended byte-position range.
